Front: What is concept drift in process mining?
Back: A situation where an event log contains data from different versions of a process, i.e., the underlying process changed over time.

Front: What are the four concept drift types?

Back: A hierarchical model representing a process using operators (sequence, choice, parallel, loop) and activity leaves.

Front: What is the difference between sudden and gradual drift?
Back: Sudden: hard switch at a single change point. Gradual: transition window where both old and new process versions overlap.

Front: What are the three state types in the thesis?
Back: Intra-case state (single running case), resource state (resource behaviour across all cases), inter-case state (global process situation).
